reason: Ten news triaged: one manually auditable security-device tamper/distributor quarantine workflow, nine no_opportunity, no speculative model/financial apps. Alleged $86m loss not asserted as independently audited.

articles.reason: CLS article combines AI infrastructure financing trend and mainland stock/ETF inflow rankings. Funding flows/ETF allocations are investment statistics, not new independently operable buyer workflow.

Japanese roundup lists existing Western/Israeli commercial AI-driven security products with Japan support. It does not disclose new regulations, novel accessible data rights or vendor-independent zero-runtime integration; existing security ledger/history also overlaps.

Impress reports Microsoft 365 Copilot PowerPoint Brand Kit and Skills general availability announced 14 September 2026, recapped 13 October. Feature is already commercial and dependent on paid Copilot; building an automated substitute would require AI runtime, so not distinct zero-external-service product.

iTnews repeats 12 October Reuters Microsoft President Brad Smith comment on the extent of AI regulation versus milk; statement is advocacy, not enacted compliance rule. Same trigger was triaged in earlier receipts.
Heise Eschborn quality assurance jobs index is a dynamic vacancy listing, not industry disruption with product opportunity.
CLS Gel Software AI initiatives and share-price movement are company financial press; no novel external software interface or mandatory workflow.
ITHome AI display glasses category page is product index, not separately dated new business/technical event.
36Kr Sankai Electromechanical B funding is an investment round, covered in adjacent catchup batch; investment alone does not prove new buyer job.

Leiphone describes Shopee marketplace content sellers accelerating multimedia promotion; to deliver full seller optimization requires vendor analytics/search rights not shown by headline. Existing marketing/app ecosystem already saturated, no distinct deterministic mechanism justified.

ZDNET 12 October reports Ledger suspended reseller CryptoBilis over hardware wallet spy-implant discovery in Southeast Asia; BleepingComputer independent reporting also describes third-party sales-channel tampering. Physical implant cannot be ruled out by standard software wallet authenticity checks. USD 86m is researcher attributed, NOT Ledger audited total. Defensive manufacturer/reseller acceptance evidence and quarantine records offer a manual no-external-API workflow.

opportunities.target_customer: Hardware-wallet and industrial secure-element device distributors, regulated retail channel auditors and corporate asset-security teams
opportunities.buyer: Distributor supply-chain quality or incident response manager
opportunities.core_job: Trace possibly tampered cryptographic devices from reseller purchase to stock quarantine, authorized inspection, customer notification and remediation signoff
opportunities.product_mechanism: User-entered supplier/reseller, order date, invoice, device serial, seal/photo inspection, lot, location, quarantine/suspicious indicator, communication and closure evidence; CSV/PDF export. Does not scan wallets, read seed phrases, verify chips or handle funds.
opportunities.before_state: Device purchase provenance, third-party inspection evidence and customer communications in disparate spreadsheets/email; chip-tampering cannot be established from a normal software authenticity signal
opportunities.after_state: Lot-level containment / contact log / inspection evidence / disposition with human approval and traceable corrective action
